SlopVector · Live

SlopVector: vector editor

Illustrator, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Download offline (.html): one file that opens from disk and works without a connection.

SlopVector has these main features: Pen, shapes, type & layers; Real pathfinder booleans. It opens SVG, Any image, Illustrator (.ai).

What you can do with SlopVector

  • Edit SVG files online
  • Convert SVG to PNG
  • A free Illustrator alternative in your browser
